sources.scientific_reference: User-supplied Chen et al. (2002) and Gross et al. (2013) articles.
sources.status: Arrhenius-only pure-binder calibration to Chen Figure 4 model curves; not experimental material measurements. q=500 and all AP-containing rates are excluded from fitting.
sources.density_cp_conductivity: All constituent density, heat capacity and conductivity values remain exactly at reference/pure_htpb.json; none are fitted.
sources.kinetics: Only binder A and E/R fitted to q=200 and 1000 pure-binder endpoints; AP kinetics unchanged. Generator converts physical A to the local phase-field rate multiplier.
sources.heat_release: Fixed Gross pure-constituent heats: HTPB -300 cal/g and AP -100 cal/g. No heat-release fitting; heat applied once during phase change with frozen gas chemistry.
sources.mixing: Supply unblended constituent values. The homogeneous phase-change model applies the requested mass/volume mixing rules once.
sources.temperature: Cold temperature 300 K retained from the original sweep.
sources.calibration: Two endpoint Arrhenius fit using temperatures from the fixed thermal balance; bounded simulation/analytic-rate correction. q=500 held out. Fixed Q implies a below-300K surface at q=200; this conditional effective fit is not a physical-property validation.
